what: A 10px blob sits at the cursor and trails behind it, closing .1 of the remaining distance each frame (at 60fps, corrected for frame length). Its corners ripple once every 5s and it rotates once per 10s. Hovering a link or button grows it to 30px over 1s cubic-bezier(.38,.19,.18,1) and tints it over .5s with that link’s color (data-blob-color). On leave it returns to the previous color right away. On fx:flood the blob grows to 250vmax in 1s, covers the screen and blocks presses, then shrinks again when detail.on is false (page transition blocking). On touch screens the blob is 0 and only does the cover.

options.follow: Follow share (fraction of the remaining distance per frame at 60fps), default .1
options.links: Target css for the grow-and-tint effect: default a, button, [data-blob-color]. Brand uses a, .tb-btn:not(.tb-nob), [data-blob-color] (the original only has a and .button, and a bare button does not grow)
options.data-blob-color (on the target): Color it tints over — via a skin variable (var(--site-pink)). Falls back to the default color if missing
options.--fx-blob · --fx-size · --fx-hover-size: Default color, size and hover size (css), defaults --kf-accent-soft · 10px · 30px
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-z: Grow duration, curve and stacking (css), default 1s · cubic-bezier(.38,.19,.18,1) · 1002
options.fx:flood: Event fired on document — detail { on: true|false, color? }. On before the turn, off when the new section comes in
options.tint: Color to tint over a colorless target (no data-blob-color), default none (keeps the default color) — theobroma uses var(--kf-bg) (every link is a background-colored blob, so the transition curtain is also the same color as the background)

use: … … · When advancing document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:flood", { detail: { on: true } }))
note: While covering, the bubble panel receives presses, so be sure to fire on: false when the transition ends. The system cursor is left as is
